item.title: Associate professor: SELECTION PROCESS FOR THE RECRUITMENT OF A SECOND-LEVEL PROFESSOR – DISCIPLINARY SCIENTIFIC GROUP: 12/GIUR-01 PRIVATE LAW, DISCIPLINARY SCIENTIFIC SECTOR: GIUR-01/A PRIVATE LAW (Telemat. G.FORTUNATO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 12:00
Institution: Telemat. G.FORTUNATO, Benevento
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-01 Diritto privato

The ideal candidate must have significant university teaching experience, preferably in e-learning mode at online universities. Proven experience in designing and managing structured e-learning courses will be valued: integrating instructional and interactive teaching, video lectures, digital materials, e-tivities, use of LMS platforms, learning monitoring, tutor coordination, and training in digital methodologies (videoconferencing alone is not sufficient). A strong aptitude for research is required, evidenced by publications, conference participation, and leading or participating in research groups in Private Law (GSD 12/GIUR-01), specifically obligations, persons, and family law.
